introHtml: Full color decoration on thunder sticks gives you the ability to print logos, team colors, or event graphics with photographic detail and bright, fade-resistant inks. Unlike single-color imprints, full color lets you replicate complex brand assets or create eye-catching designs that stand out in stadiums or parades. These foam sticks are lightweight and safe for indoor or outdoor use, making them a popular giveaway for sports teams, fan rallies, and promotional events where high visibility matters.
